serverInfo.name: sap.s4/material-stock-mcp-server
serverInfo.title: SAP S/4 Material Stock MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Reads material stock levels from SAP S/4HANA via OGS_S4 destination for mass balance reconciliation

tools.name: get_metadata_api_material_stock_srv
tools.title: get_metadata_api_material_stock_srv
tools.description: Get metadata of the OData service.

tools.name: list_a_materialstock_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.title: list_A_MaterialStock_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.description: Retrieve a list of material stock entities. Supports OData query options for filtering, sorting, paging, expanding, counting, and selecting specific properties.

tools.name: get_a_materialstock_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.title: get_A_MaterialStock_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.description: Retrieve a single material stock entity by material number.

tools.name: count_a_materialstock_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.title: count_A_MaterialStock_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.description: Get total count of material stock entities matching a filter.

tools.name: list_a_matlstkinacctmod_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.title: list_A_MatlStkInAcctMod_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.description: Retrieve material stocks in account model. Filter by plant, storage location, batch, stock type. Returns MatlWrhsStkQtyInMatlBaseUnit for mass balance calculations.

tools.name: get_a_matlstkinacctmod_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.title: get_A_MatlStkInAcctMod_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.description: Retrieve a single material stock in account model by full key.

tools.name: count_a_matlstkinacctmod_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.title: count_A_MatlStkInAcctMod_for_api_material_stock_srv
tools.description: Get total count of material stocks in account model matching a filter.
